### Included in the Covenant
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/included-in-the-covenant
Passage: Psalm 132:17-18
Points:
- God's covenant promises to David extend to everyone who comes to Christ in faith.
- Because believers are united to Jesus, David's promised blessings become ours.
- The sprouting horn signifies divine power actively fighting for and shielding God's people.
- The prepared lamp promises that God's light will sustain believers and conquer darkness.
- Sharing in David's crown means believers will reign eternally alongside the exalted Son of David.

### A Commitment to Worship
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/commitment-worship
Passage: Psalm 132:1-10
Points:
- David's intense zeal for the presence of the Lord demonstrates what it means to seek God's heart.
- David refused to settle into comfort until a proper dwelling place was prepared for God's ark.
- Wholehearted worship aligns human priorities with God's supreme goal of exalting His own name.
- Under the new covenant, believers themselves serve as temples of the indwelling Holy Spirit.
- Christians honor God by pursuing lives marked by repentance, humility, and holiness.

### A Promise, a Manger, and a City with No Need for the Sun
Author: Jonathan Parnell
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/a-promise-a-manger-and-a-city-with-no-need-for-the-sun
Passage: Psalm 132:17
Points:
- Psalm 132 unites two essential biblical themes: God's dwelling presence and His kingly rule.
- While the psalmist looked for a geographic sanctuary, God embodied both realities in Jesus Christ.
- The promised horn of David arrives in the incarnation, bringing divine authority to humanity.
- The psalm's ultimate fulfillment looks past Christ's first coming to His final reign in Revelation.
- Celebrating the Savior's birth directs believers to look forward eagerly to His triumphant return.
